title: RNA Extraction with Trizol for Cells
author: Maria Cármen Sales
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ssheeb6

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Remove culture medium from the plate and lyse the cells using Trizol.

substeps.instruction: Add 750μl of Trizol to 1 x 10^5 - 10^7 cells.
Homogenize the mixture with a pipette.
Transfer the sample to a tube.
Optional: Store the sample in a -80°C freezer for up to 6 months or proceed immediately.

steps.title: Nucleoprotein Dissociation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 5 minutes to allow complete dissociation of the nucleoproteins complex.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA from proteins and lipids using chloroform and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μl of chloroform per 1 mL of Trizol used.
Incubate for 2 to 3 minutes.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 12,000 xg at 4°C.

steps.title: Aqueous Phase Recovery
steps.instruction: Collect the colorless upper aqueous phase containing the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Angle the tube at 45°.
Pipette the aqueous phase out and transfer it to a new tube.
Add 500 μl of isopropanol per 1 mL of Trizol used.
Incubate for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 12,000 xg at 4°C.

steps.title: RNA Pellet Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with ethanol to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant using a micropipette.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of 75% ethanol per 1 mL of Trizol used.
Vortex the sample briefly.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 7500 xg at 4°C.

steps.title: Pellet Drying
steps.instruction: Remove remaining ethanol and dry the RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant with a micropipettor.
Vacuum or air dry the RNA pellet for 5–10 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried RNA pellet in a suitable solvent.

substeps.instruction: Add 20–50 µL of RNase-free water, 0.1 mM EDTA, or 0.5% SDS solution.
Resuspend by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Final Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the resuspended RNA in a water bath or heat block set at 55–60°C for 10–15 minutes.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Store the RNA in a -80°C freezer until use or proceed immediately to the cDNA reaction.
